The Hot Dog Trail

What's on the Hot Dog Trail?

The Hot Dog Trail is a trail with 8 stops: Nathan's Famous (Coney Island, Brooklyn), Gray's Papaya (Upper West Side), Gus's Hot Dogs (Watervliet), Famous Lunch (Troy), Clare & Carl's (Plattsburgh) and Heid's of Liverpool (Liverpool). Tip: Read the field guide below before you go, so you know how to order.

Coney Island to Buffalo by way of the North Country. Eight stands, eight styles.
